resources.string: Create an API account at last.fm/api/account/create and enter exactly the callback URL shown below as its Callback URL. Then enter its API key and shared secret here and tap Sign in with browser. You log in and approve on last.fm itself; Telos never sees your Last.fm password.
Callback URL for your Last.fm API account
Waiting for you to approve in the browser…
No browser found to open last.fm
No Last.fm sign in was started in the app, the answer was ignored
The sign in took longer than 10 minutes. Try again
Last.fm sign in failed. Check the API key, the shared secret and the callback URL
Last.fm sends no verification value back, so the answer is only accepted for 10 minutes after you tapped the button, and only once.
